findings.title: No API Interface — File-Based Integration Only
findings.description: The system exposes no REST, GraphQL, or AsyncAPI interface. Integration requires file-based exchange: COBOL batch reads indexed employee master files and writes fixed-width flat files transferred via plaintext FTP to an EC2 gateway.
findings.gap: No API exists. Only file-based integration via plaintext FTP — brittle, non-auditable, non-programmatic coupling.
findings.recommendation: Build a REST API wrapper with OpenAPI specification exposing payroll operations (submit run, query status, retrieve results).

findings.title: No Machine-Readable API Specification
findings.description: No HTTP/RPC surface exists — machine-readable spec is not applicable. The system is a batch processor with file-based I/O only.
findings.gap: No API surface to describe with a machine-readable spec.
findings.recommendation: Include OpenAPI spec generation as a requirement in API modernization.

findings.title: No Structured Error Responses
findings.description: No HTTP/RPC surface — structured error responses are not applicable. Minimal error handling exists (AT END on READ only).
findings.gap: No API surface; no error structures.
findings.recommendation: Design structured error response format as part of API development.

findings.title: No Idempotency Protection on Write Operations
findings.description: The batch payroll job has no idempotency protection. Duplicate execution produces duplicate payout records with no deduplication logic or unique constraint enforcement.
findings.gap: No idempotency keys, no deduplication logic, no duplicate-run detection.
findings.recommendation: Add pay-period identifier and duplicate-run detection before processing.

ara_metadata.conditional_resolution: Resolved to BLOCKER: agent_scope=write-enabled AND no idempotency mechanism exists.
ara_metadata.resolution_reasoning: The batch job writes payout records without deduplication. An agent triggering this job would produce duplicate payroll disbursements on retry.

findings.title: No Async Operation Support for Long-Running Batch
findings.description: Batch job runs 5-7 hours with no async patterns — no job submission API, no polling endpoint, no webhook callback, no status query mechanism.
findings.gap: No async operation support for long-running batch process.
findings.recommendation: Implement job submission and status polling API.

findings.title: No Event Emission for State Changes
findings.description: No event emission capability exists. No webhooks, no SNS/EventBridge integration. Only output is flat file written and FTPed.
findings.gap: No event-driven integration surface.
findings.recommendation: Add EventBridge events for payroll lifecycle (started, completed, failed).

findings.title: No Machine Identity Authentication
findings.description: No machine identity authentication mechanism exists. Only a hardcoded FTP username/password (payroll/PayR0ll2003!) in the JCL — no OAuth2, no API keys, no mTLS, no principal attribution.
findings.gap: No machine identity authentication. Agent cannot authenticate with a distinct, attributable identity.
findings.recommendation: Implement service accounts with OAuth2 client credentials on modernized API.

findings.title: No Scoped Permissions
findings.description: No authorization model exists. Any process that can access files or trigger JCL has full access to all employee data and all payroll operations.
findings.gap: No scoped permissions, no IAM policies, no role differentiation.
findings.recommendation: Implement IAM-based RBAC with distinct agent roles (read-only, execute-payroll, admin).

findings.title: No Action-Level Authorization
findings.description: No action-level authorization. Cannot distinguish between read and write at authorization level. A caller can execute all operations.
findings.gap: No ABAC, no fine-grained RBAC, no action-level checks.
findings.recommendation: Design action-level permissions as part of API modernization.

findings.title: No Identity Propagation or Delegation
findings.description: No identity propagation mechanism. Cannot distinguish agent-as-self from agent-on-behalf-of-user. No JWT, no OAuth2, no token exchange.
findings.gap: No identity propagation, no on-behalf-of flows.
findings.recommendation: Implement OAuth2 with on-behalf-of flows in modernized API.

findings.title: Hardcoded Credentials in Source Code
findings.description: FTP credentials hardcoded in plaintext in JCL: username 'payroll', password 'PayR0ll2003!'. Committed to version control. No secrets management, no rotation.
findings.gap: Hardcoded credentials in source. No secrets management. No rotation.
findings.recommendation: Remove hardcoded credentials. Implement AWS Secrets Manager with automated rotation.

findings.title: No Immutable Audit Logging
findings.description: No audit logging exists. No CloudTrail, no immutable log storage, no principal attribution on write operations. SYSOUT is transient with no retention policy.
findings.gap: Zero audit trail. No immutable logging. No principal attribution.
findings.recommendation: Implement immutable audit logs (CloudTrail) with principal attribution for every operation.

ara_metadata.conditional_resolution: Resolved to BLOCKER: agent_scope=write-enabled AND no audit logging exists.
ara_metadata.resolution_reasoning: The system performs write operations (payroll calculation and disbursement) with zero audit trail. An agent executing these operations would leave no traceable record.

findings.title: No Agent Identity Suspension Mechanism
findings.description: System does not issue or enforce agent identities — suspension is a consumer responsibility. No identity lifecycle management exists.
findings.gap: No identity lifecycle management.
findings.recommendation: Include identity suspension capability in modernized auth design.

findings.title: No Compensation or Rollback Capability
findings.description: No compensation or rollback. Once the job writes payout records and FTPs the file, there is no undo. Partial failure leaves inconsistent state.
findings.gap: No saga, no compensating transactions, no undo endpoints, no rollback states.
findings.recommendation: Implement two-phase execution with explicit commit step and compensation logic.

ara_metadata.conditional_resolution: Resolved to BLOCKER: agent_scope=write-enabled AND no rollback/compensation exists.
ara_metadata.resolution_reasoning: The batch job writes payroll disbursement records with no undo capability. An agent-triggered erroneous run cannot be reversed.

findings.title: No Queryable Current State
findings.description: System does not expose current state in any queryable form. Cannot inspect payroll status or last run before acting.
findings.gap: No state query mechanism. No GET/status APIs.
findings.recommendation: Expose current state (last run, status, record count) via query API.

findings.title: No Concurrency Controls
findings.description: No concurrency controls. Concurrent execution produces duplicate payout records. No locking, no version fields, no conditional writes.
findings.gap: No concurrency protection mechanisms.
findings.recommendation: Implement mutual exclusion and idempotency checks.

findings.title: No Circuit Breakers or Resilience Patterns
findings.description: No circuit breakers, retry logic, or timeout configurations for the FTP dependency (EC2 gateway at 10.0.7.40). Failure handling is absent.
findings.gap: No resilience patterns for external dependencies.
findings.recommendation: Implement retry with circuit breaker for file transfer step.

findings.title: Rate Limiting Not Applicable — No API Surface
findings.description: System exposes no HTTP/RPC surface — API-layer rate limiting is not applicable. Batch-only system triggered by CA-7 scheduler.
findings.gap: No API surface to rate-limit.
findings.recommendation: Include rate limiting in modernized API architecture.

findings.title: No Blast Radius or Transaction Limits
findings.description: No transaction limits. Batch processes ALL employees with no configurable caps on records or disbursement amounts.
findings.gap: No blast radius limits. No per-run caps.
findings.recommendation: Add configurable limits on records processed and total disbursement amount.

findings.title: No Graceful Degradation Signaling
findings.description: No degradation signaling. No health endpoints, no freshness indicators, no machine-readable status signals.
findings.gap: No degradation signaling mechanism.
findings.recommendation: Implement health/status endpoints with data freshness.

findings.title: No Draft/Pending State
findings.description: No draft or pending state. Batch job immediately processes and outputs final payroll records with no intermediate review step.
findings.gap: No intermediate reviewable state. All writes immediately committed.
findings.recommendation: Implement two-phase execution with human approval before financial disbursement.

findings.title: No Configurable Approval Gates
findings.description: No configurable approval gates. JCL job runs both steps automatically with no mechanism to require human approval before high-risk operations.
findings.gap: No operation-level approval configuration.
findings.recommendation: Implement approval gates for financial disbursement and data transmission.

findings.title: No Sandbox/Staging Environment
findings.description: No dedicated sandbox. Changes validated in shared QA region only — not isolated, not production-equivalent.
findings.gap: No isolated testing environment with production-equivalent data shape.
findings.recommendation: Create sandbox with synthetic payroll data (no real SSNs) for agent testing.

findings.title: Sensitive Data Exposed Without Scoping
findings.description: System processes SSN (EMP-SSN) and bank account numbers (EMP-ACCT) with no output filtering. All sensitive fields are written to payout file and transmitted via plaintext FTP. No access control differentiation. No formal classification.
findings.gap: B1: Sensitive data in all output without filtering. B2: No access control differentiation. B3: No classification metadata.
findings.recommendation: Implement field-level output filtering. Tokenize sensitive identifiers. Separate access controls for sensitive data.

ara_metadata.conditional_resolution: Resolved to BLOCKER: agent_scope=write-enabled AND B1 fires (sensitive fields in output).
ara_metadata.resolution_reasoning: EMP-SSN and EMP-ACCT are included in all system output with no filtering. An agent consuming this data would receive unmasked SSN and bank account numbers.

b1.reasoning: SSN and bank account numbers output unfiltered in payout records.

b2.reasoning: No access control differentiation — single access level for all data.

b3.reasoning: No formal data classification metadata exists.

findings.title: Data Residency Violation — Plaintext PII Transfer
findings.description: US-regulated PII (SSN) transmitted via plaintext FTP from mainframe to EC2 gateway with no encryption, no region controls, no residency configuration.
findings.gap: No data residency controls. No encryption in transit. PII crosses boundaries unprotected.
findings.recommendation: Replace plaintext FTP with encrypted transfer. Document and enforce data residency requirements.

ara_metadata.conditional_resolution: Resolved to BLOCKER: agent_scope=write-enabled AND regulated PII transmitted without encryption.
ara_metadata.resolution_reasoning: SSN data is transmitted via plaintext FTP. An agent sending this data to an LLM endpoint would compound the residency violation.

findings.title: No Input Validation or Schema Enforcement
findings.description: No input validation at any boundary. COBOL reads records trusting all input — no range checks, no schema enforcement, no structured rejection.
findings.gap: No validation. Corrupt input produces incorrect payroll silently.
findings.recommendation: Add input validation with range checks for all employee record fields.

findings.title: No Temporal Metadata or Freshness Signals
findings.description: No timestamps on records. FICA wage base from 2019 still in use (VALUE 132900.00). No freshness signaling.
findings.gap: No temporal metadata. Stale reference data in use.
findings.recommendation: Add timestamps to records. Automate reference data currency checks.

findings.title: No PII Redaction in Logs or Outputs
findings.description: No PII redaction anywhere. SSN and bank account numbers flow through system unmasked into output files and SYSOUT.
findings.gap: Zero PII redaction. SSN and bank accounts visible in all outputs.
findings.recommendation: Implement PII masking (last-4 SSN, tokenized accounts) across all output surfaces.

findings.title: No Data Quality Awareness
findings.description: No data quality metrics. Tax tables updated manually. FICA wage base stale since 2019.
findings.gap: No quality metrics, no automated freshness checks.
findings.recommendation: Implement data quality monitoring and staleness alerts.

findings.title: No Schema Versioning or API Contracts
findings.description: No schema versioning. Fixed-width 120-byte record format is undocumented outside COBOL source. No versioning, no changelog, no breaking-change detection.
findings.gap: No versioning. Format changes break consumers silently.
findings.recommendation: Document record layout formally. Implement schema versioning.

findings.title: Legacy COBOL Field Naming Conventions
findings.description: Field names use COBOL-era abbreviated naming (EMP-SSN, EMP-ACCT, WS-FICA). Somewhat interpretable but require domain knowledge.
findings.gap: Legacy naming conventions require mapping for modern consumption.
findings.recommendation: Create field-name mapping. Use clear names in modernized interfaces.

findings.title: No Data Catalog or Metadata Layer
findings.description: No data catalog. Only documentation is COBOL FD sections and README.
findings.gap: No metadata layer, no formal data dictionary.
findings.recommendation: Create formal data dictionary documenting all entities and fields.

findings.title: No Distributed Tracing or Structured Logging
findings.description: No HTTP/RPC surface — no agent-initiated request path to trace. SYSOUT is unstructured with no trace or correlation IDs.
findings.gap: No request path to trace; no structured logging.
findings.recommendation: Include OpenTelemetry instrumentation in modernized architecture.

findings.title: No Alerting Configuration
findings.description: No HTTP/RPC surface — API-level alerting is not applicable. No alerting configuration exists.
findings.gap: No alerting thresholds configured.
findings.recommendation: Implement CloudWatch alarms on modernized API.

findings.title: No Infrastructure as Code
findings.description: No HTTP/RPC and no auth surface — IaC governance not applicable. No Terraform, CloudFormation, or CDK. Manual mainframe configuration.
findings.gap: No IaC; no agent-facing infrastructure to govern.
findings.recommendation: Adopt IaC (Terraform or CDK) from day one in modernization.

findings.title: No CI/CD Pipeline
findings.description: No HTTP/RPC surface — API contract testing not applicable. No CI/CD pipeline exists at all.
findings.gap: No CI/CD; no automated contract testing.
findings.recommendation: Implement CI/CD with contract testing when API is built.

findings.title: No Rollback Capability
findings.description: No deployed HTTP/RPC surface — deployment rollback not applicable. GDG provides generational file versioning only.
findings.gap: No deployment rollback mechanism.
findings.recommendation: Design rollback capability into modernized deployment.

findings.title: Zero Automated Test Coverage
findings.description: No automated tests of any kind. Changes validated in shared QA region only. No unit, integration, or contract tests.
findings.gap: Zero test coverage. No automated validation.
findings.recommendation: Create automated tests for payroll calculations with known-answer datasets.

findings.title: No Encryption at Rest
findings.description: No encryption at rest for data stores containing SSN and bank accounts. No KMS, no encryption config visible.
findings.gap: Sensitive PII stored unencrypted.
findings.recommendation: Implement KMS-managed encryption for all data at rest containing PII.

evaluations.title: Structured Response Format
evaluations.reason: No API/serialization surface exists — informational signal, no finding emitted.

evaluations.title: Rate Limit Documentation and Headers
evaluations.reason: No API/HTTP surface exists — informational signal, no finding emitted.

evaluations.title: Selective Query Support
evaluations.reason: Extended question not triggered — system has no list/query endpoints with potentially unbounded results.

evaluations.title: Business Outcome Metrics
evaluations.reason: No metrics or telemetry surface exists — informational signal, no finding emitted.

items.summary: Resolve all BLOCKERs and critical RISK-SAFETY findings: build API surface, implement machine identity, add audit logging, enable rollback, protect sensitive data, and add human-in-the-loop gates.
Address remaining RISK-SAFETY and RISK-QUALITY findings: add resilience patterns, concurrency controls, input validation, async support, and test coverage.
Address INFO-level improvements: add observability, IaC governance, CI/CD, schema documentation, and data quality monitoring.

recommended_actions.action: Modernize integration surface — replace file-based FTP with REST API
recommended_actions.rationale: The system has no API. All agent integration is blocked until a programmatic interface exists.

recommended_actions.action: Deploy centralized identity and auth framework
recommended_actions.rationale: No authentication, authorization, or audit logging exists. Machine identity is a prerequisite for all other security controls.

recommended_actions.action: Implement sensitive data protection — encryption and scoping
recommended_actions.rationale: SSN and bank accounts are exposed in plaintext via unencrypted FTP. Critical compliance risk.

recommended_actions.action: Add transaction safety controls — rollback, limits, and approval gates
recommended_actions.rationale: Write operations are irreversible with no blast radius limits or human oversight.
Zero automated tests and no CI/CD means changes cannot be validated safely.
